surface/primary: Main background for screens, cards, and modals
surface/tertiary: Recessed or inset backgrounds, separator areas
surface/overlay: Semi-transparent scrim behind modals and drawers
surface/elevated: Elevated surfaces like sheets, drawers, and popovers
text/primary: Headings, titles, and primary body text
text/tertiary: Meta text, timestamps, and badge labels
border/focus: Focus rings and keyboard navigation indicators
action/primaryContent: Text and icons on primary buttons
action/secondaryContent: Text and icons on secondary buttons
action/tertiaryContent: Text and icons on tertiary buttons
action/destructiveContent: Text and icons on destructive buttons
action/disabledContent: Text and icons on disabled buttons
action/ghostContent: Text and icons on ghost buttons
input/error: Input error border and message color
accent/primary: Brand accent color, links, active elements
accent/content: Text and icons on accent-colored surfaces
